name: taskattest
description: Check a coding agent's "done" before it stops: deterministic rules over the files it produced, what it did, and what it changed. Blocks the stop with structured fixes, hands over to a person after repeated failures, and leaves an evidence bundle. No model calls, no dependencies.

python.title: Python command
python.description: Python 3.10 or newer, as a command on PATH or a full path. On Windows `python3` is often the Store stub; use `python` or the full path to python.exe.
